title: Add delta significance scorer and prose annotator for release notes
author: Sofia Patel
release_notes: Add automated delta significance scoring to prioritize changelog entries and a lightweight prose annotator that generates human-readable release bullets. CLI flag --release-grade introduced for curated release drafts. No breaking changes. There's an opt-out label "no-autogen" to prevent automatic drafting for sensitive models.
description: Motivation: As the model registry accumulates many small metadata and profile deltas during onboarding and routine recalibrations, release notes become noisy. This PR implements a statistical 'delta significance' scorer to rank profile/metadata changes by practical importance across sampled cohorts and couples it with a prose annotator that drafts concise human-friendly release bullets. The goal is to surface the small set of meaningful changes for release notes and reduce manual curation time. Summary of changes: 1) new scoring module registry/scorers/delta_significance.py that computes cohort-aware z-score and effect-size heuristics with bootstrapped confidence intervals, including A/B naming compatibility checks; 2) prose annotator registry/notes/prose_annotator.py that converts scored deltas into templated natural-language bullets with placeholders for metric, direction, p-value, and suggested callouts; 3) CLI integration cli/release_drafts.py with new --release-grade and --sample-size options to generate a draft.md for reviewers; 4) orchestration hook registry/hooks/changelog_autogen.py that filters deltas by threshold and invokes the annotator; 5) tests and sampling harness tests/test_delta_scorer.py and tests/test_prose_annotator.py; 6) docs update docs/model-registry/release-notes-guidelines.md describing how scores map to priority tiers and reviewer workflows. Privacy and stability: the scorer operates on aggregated profile statistics (no raw prompts), and default sampling is limited to 1,000 examples per cohort to bound cost. There's an opt-out label "no-autogen" to prevent automatic drafting for sensitive models. Backwards compatibility: default thresholds match previous manual heuristics so existing release pipelines are unaffected unless teams opt into --release-grade. Checklist: - [x] Scorer implementation with unit tests - [x] Prose annotator + deterministic templating - [x] CLI integration and docs - [x] Add opt-out label and sampling limit - [x] End-to-end test generating a sample draft.md How it works (short): delta_significance computes per-metric delta, pooled variance, and then a two-sided effect-size with bootstrap CI. We combine effect-size and CI width into a single 'impact' score and normalize by historical volatility for a model family. The annotator maps score bands to prose templates (e.g., "Minor decrease in accuracy on X (-0.6 pts, p=0.08) — recommend continued monitoring") and attaches a contextual note when sample sizes are small. Testing summary: unit tests cover edge cases (zero variance, tiny cohorts), integration tests exercise CLI generation on synthetic profiles, and a smoke test verifies that autogen skips models labeled "no-autogen". Rationale for thresholds and defaults are documented in the release-notes-guidelines. Commits: - 7d4a1b2 add delta_significance scorer and bootstrap utils - 2c3f8d4 add prose_annotator with templating and english presets - b1f9d55 add CLI --release-grade and sampling flags - e3b2d11 wire changelog_autogen hook into on-board pipeline - 9f07c4a tests for scorer and annotator, add CI flaky-test guard - f4a6ea8 docs: release notes guidelines and UX screenshots Changed files (high-level): - registry/scorers/delta_significance.py (new) - registry/notes/prose_annotator.py (new) - registry/hooks/changelog_autogen.py (new) - cli/release_drafts.py (new) - tests/test_delta_scorer.py (new) - tests/test_prose_annotator.py (new) - docs/model-registry/release-notes-guidelines.md (updated) - changelogs/sample_drafts/draft-70219.md (generated example) Reviews and comments timeline: - Diego Martinez (reviewer) — "Nice approach; a couple of asks: 1) constrain default sample size to 1k (costs), 2) add warning when CI spans zero so we don't overstate significance." Author reply (Sofia Patel) — "Agreed on 1k default, implemented as --sample-size default and documented it. Added CI span warning in annotator and a confidence label in draft output." - Lena Zhou (reviewer) — "Can we expose an API for external tooling to pull scored deltas as JSON? Also please add a gate to avoid autogen for models older than 6 months without human review." Author reply — "Added registry/api/scored_deltas_handler.py and an optional 'age_gate_days' arg. Default left unset to avoid behavior changes; documented in the new guide." - Priya Rao (reviewer) — "Unit tests look good. Add an integration test exercising the opt-out label and ensure draft generation respects model visibility (private vs public)." Author reply — "Added integration tests and fixed draft permission logic; CI updated." CI: initial run showed a flaky test failure in tests/test_prose_annotator (string ordering in templates) — fixed by normalizing template outputs and re-running CI. Final CI status: all checks passing (unit, integration, lint, mypy, docs-build). Merge decision: approved by reviewers, squash merge applied on 2024-11-04 with change title "Add delta significance scorer and prose annotator for release notes". Follow-ups: - ENG-3421: tune threshold mapping for enterprise models (low priority) - ENG-3487: add localization and longer-form prose mode for release managers (next quarter) Notes for release engineers: the new CLI produces changelogs/sample_drafts/draft-70219.md; use --release-grade to apply prioritized filtering. To opt-out for a specific model, add label "no-autogen" to the model's registry entry. If you see unexpected omissions, rerun with --sample-size 5000 to increase power at cost.
